es.summary: Un usuario desactivó un control de seguridad crítico en GitHub a nivel de enterprise, organización o repositorio: GitHub Advanced Security, las restricciones de OAuth apps o el requisito de 2FA.
es.what_it_detects: Eventos del audit log de GitHub cuyo campo action es uno de los diez valores de desactivación: business_advanced_security.*, org.advanced_security_*disabled*, org.disable_oauth_app_restrictions, org.disable_two_factor_requirement o repo.advanced_security_disabled.
es.why_it_matters: Quitar 2FA, las restricciones de OAuth o el escaneo de Advanced Security debilita la autenticación y la detección de secretos y vulnerabilidades. Corresponde a T1556 (modificar el proceso de autenticación) y sirve para persistencia o para debilitar defensas.
triage_steps: Identifique action, actor, org, repo, business y la marca de tiempo del evento para saber qué control se desactivó y su alcance.
Confirme con el actor o su responsable si existe un cambio aprobado o ticket que justifique la desactivación.
Revise actor_ip y user_agent: compárelos con el historial del actor y busque IP inusuales, VPN o geolocalizaciones nuevas.
Busque en el audit log otras acciones del mismo actor +/- 15 minutos: altas de owners, nuevos tokens, OAuth apps, deploy keys, cambios de branch protection.
Si se desactivó 2FA, liste miembros que luego eliminaron su segundo factor o se unieron sin él.
Si se quitaron restricciones OAuth, revise qué OAuth apps obtuvieron acceso a la organización después del cambio.
Consulte alertas previas del mismo actor o IP, incluidos inicios de sesión fallidos o reseteos de credenciales.
false_positives: Actividad aprobada de administradores u owners, documentada en un cambio o ticket.
Ajustes de licenciamiento de GitHub Advanced Security que desactivan la función en repositorios archivados o de prueba.
Migración a otro proveedor de identidad o SSO, donde el 2FA de GitHub se reemplaza por controles del IdP.
response_steps: Si no hay aprobación, vuelva a habilitar el control afectado (2FA, restricciones OAuth o Advanced Security) tras coordinar con los owners.
Suspenda sesiones y revoque tokens, PAT y claves SSH del actor si se sospecha que la cuenta está comprometida.
Revise y revoque OAuth apps, tokens o colaboradores agregados durante la ventana del incidente.
Restablezca credenciales del actor, exija 2FA y revise el resto del audit log para delimitar el alcance.
es.severity_rationale: El nivel high es adecuado porque cada acción elimina un control preventivo o de detección a escala de organización o repositorio y rara vez ocurre sin un cambio planificado.

en.summary: A user disabled a critical GitHub security control at enterprise, organization or repository level: GitHub Advanced Security, OAuth app restrictions or the 2FA requirement.
en.what_it_detects: GitHub audit log events whose action field is one of ten disable values: business_advanced_security.*, org.advanced_security_*disabled*, org.disable_oauth_app_restrictions, org.disable_two_factor_requirement or repo.advanced_security_disabled.
en.why_it_matters: Removing 2FA, OAuth restrictions or Advanced Security scanning weakens authentication and secret/vulnerability detection. This maps to T1556 (modify authentication process) and supports persistence or defense impairment.
triage_steps: Record action, actor, org, repo, business and timestamp to know which control was disabled and its scope.
Confirm with the actor or their manager whether an approved change or ticket justifies the action.
Check actor_ip and user_agent against the actor's history; look for unusual IPs, VPNs or new geolocations.
Search the audit log for the same actor within +/- 15 minutes: new owners, tokens, OAuth apps, deploy keys, branch protection changes.
If 2FA was disabled, list members who later removed their second factor or joined without one.
If OAuth restrictions were removed, review which OAuth apps gained organization access afterwards.
Check earlier alerts for the same actor or IP, including failed logins or credential resets.
false_positives: Approved administrator or owner activity documented in a change or ticket.
GitHub Advanced Security licensing adjustments disabling the feature on archived or test repositories.
Migration to an identity provider or SSO where GitHub 2FA is replaced by IdP controls.
response_steps: If unapproved, re-enable the affected control (2FA, OAuth restrictions or Advanced Security) after coordinating with owners.
If account compromise is suspected, revoke the actor's sessions, tokens, PATs and SSH keys.
Review and revoke OAuth apps, tokens or collaborators added during the incident window.
Reset the actor's credentials, enforce 2FA and review the wider audit log to scope impact.
en.severity_rationale: High fits because each action removes a preventive or detective control at organization or repository scale and rarely happens outside a planned change.
